observed_dpsdk.wire_dispatch: comm/dummy_node.cpp copies request.operation directly into ManagementRequest

impact: The operation/receipt/result/core-state enum drift is resolved by DPSDK commit a24c017.
Runtime status identity is resolved by DPSDK commit 648582f.
DummyNode manage_v1 responses do not set device_id, profile_id, or operation_status; the production client rejects SELECT_CONTROL_MODE receipt identity before continuing bootstrap.
ros_behavior: ROS uses the published C05 values, accepts no legacy aliases, and retains strict runtime contract/profile/permit validation.
resolution_required: Resolved: DPSDK maps published wire operation values and D06 passes 26/26.
Resolved: D08 publishes runtime hashes and authorization status, with DISARMED raw-state visibility.
Every manage_v1 receipt/query response must populate device_id and profile_id from the addressed device/request.
GET_OPERATION terminal responses must populate the C05 operation_status value in addition to result_code.
D06/D08 acceptance must assert these decoded response fields for SELECT, GRANT, CAPTURE, PERMIT and ENABLE.
ROS reruns R06 and R07 cross-process cases against that committed artifact.
